items.title: The 5 Phases of a Project Management Plan (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the five project phases (PDF 16-17).

blocks.text: Project management plan paanch marahil se guzarta hai, jo kitab ki be-number figure mein dikhaye gaye hain.

items: Initiation (aaghaz): project ka khayal wazeh aur manzoor hota hai.
Planning: kaam, afraad, timelines aur kharche tay hote hain.
Execution (amal): team kaam karti aur product banati hai.
Performance monitoring (nigrani): taraqqi, kharche aur maiyar ko mansoobe se jaancha jata hai.
Project closure (ikhtitam): mukammal product hawale kar ke project band kiya jata hai.

blocks.alt: Oopar baen: initiation se closure tak project ke paanch marahil ke dabbe, planning, timelines, kharche, kharche ki misal aur khatron ke qadmon ke notes ke saath. Oopar daen: library system ka use case diagram jis mein librarian aur student Borrow book aur Return book se jure hain. Neeche: Room, Box aur ToyBox, BookBox aur ClothesBox classes wala class diagram.
blocks.caption: Project planning, khatron ka intezam, use case aur class diagrams (Figures 1.9 aur 1.10 aur planning topics ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Project initiation, planning, execution, performance monitoring aur closure se guzarta hai. Us ka mansooba tay karta hai ke kya, kaun aur kab karega, aur us ka kharcha team, technology, muddat, khatron aur quality assurance par munhasir hai; khatre pehchane, jaanche, kam kiye aur nigrani mein rakhe jate hain. Use case diagram nizam ke bahar ke log ya nizam, jaise librarian aur student, aur woh maqasid dikhata hai jo woh nizam se hasil karte hain, jaise kitab udhaar lena aur wapas karna. Class diagram classes ko un ke data aur kaamon aur aapas ke rishton ke saath dikhata hai: kamre mein dabbe hain, aur khilone, kitabon aur kapron ke dabbe dabbe ki khaas qismein hain.

blocks.prompt: Kis marhale mein taraqqi, kharche aur maiyar ka mansoobe se muwazna hota hai?
blocks.explanation: Performance monitoring, chautha marhala, jo execution ke doran aur baad mein aur project closure se pehle aata hai.

items: Paanch marahil: initiation, planning, execution, performance monitoring, project closure.
